quests.title: World Historian Expedition
quests.description: Journey through world history and understand the forces that shaped civilizations!

story.introduction: The World History Institute has opened a portal to the past! Explore different civilizations and understand their contributions to human progress.

steps.title: Renaissance Revolution Investigation
steps.narrative: Professor Timeline takes you to Renaissance Italy. Investigate how this period changed European culture.

problem.question: What was the most significant impact of the Renaissance on European society?
problem.sample_answer: The Renaissance brought humanism, scientific thinking, and artistic innovation that transformed European society from medieval to modern...
problem.explanation: Students should discuss humanism, scientific method, art, literature, and the shift from religious to secular thinking.
